card.name: The first name Roger before a surname
card.fires_on: The first name Roger (or Rog-) when it begins a person's full name, especially an author, historian or scholar, just before the surname. It also fires weakly on the middle initial after Roger.

modes.label: Roger as first name
modes.description: The name Roger appears as an author or expert's first name, right before a surname.

modes.label: After Roger
modes.description: The initial or name part following Roger, such as G. in Roger G. Kennedy.

card.plain: It spots the first name Roger at the start of a person's name, where a surname comes next.
